verdict.rationale: HubSpot's official MCP server gives any MCP-compatible agent read and write access to CRM deals and engagements, so an agent can in principle read email and meeting activity and update deal records. HubSpot's own smart deal progression also advances deals and handles next steps after calls and meetings. However, the evidence never shows the agent-facing API or MCP path writing deal stages or next-step fields specifically. missing for 10: documented deal-stage and next-step write operations via the API or MCP tools, evidence that smart deal progression is exposed to external agents, hands-on corroboration of an agent driving stage changes from email and meeting signals.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent update deal stages and next steps from email and meeting signals via the API or MCP server

citations.quote: The HubSpot MCP server enables you to give any MCP-compatible AI tool or agent secure read and write access to your HubSpot CRM data — contacts, deals, engagements, and more.
smart deal progression keeps deals moving after every call, with next steps handled for them.
Approve automatic CRM updates and follow-up drafts after every meeting
the webhooks journal API enables third-party integrators to subscribe to real-time events, retrieve historical event data, and manage snapshots of CRM objects
